title: RFC027 real market-maker bot testnet rollout and MAHI stale-replace hardening
status: kept diagnostic; clean reset completed; local bridge mutators fail closed by default; public faucet is consensus-carried; browser activation uses EVM-wallet owner calls; RFC027 Rust MM is running; public SDK acceptance proves account/faucet/policy/deposit/trade/risk/candle flow on reset testnet; Python LLM taker fleet is redeployed from ignored Ansible secret env and submitting IOC taker intents

history_ingested.summary: The full chain/experiments ledger was re-ingested before continuing the RFC027 MM/taker rollout. The ledger is a numbered sequence focused on reproducible testnet deployments, exact binary hashes, topology, observed failures, and kept/binned conclusions. Items 245-265 establish that submitted/accepted request counts are not enough; common-height block/state roots, drained MAHI queues, and host/topology controls are the correctness gates. Items 266-267 show local live-flag mismatches can create misleading failures. Items 270-275 establish the current four-validator testnet context, runner topology, green floor, and known MAHI/ingress-tail sensitivity. Item 276 records the RFC027 live rollout and must keep distinguishing bot submission, committed state-root convergence, runtime event/trade-history visibility, and market-data ingestion.

rules: Do not treat zero RPC, nonce, or network errors as a green result without common-height committed state-root agreement and drained MAHI submit queues.
Do not treat submitted bot intents as executed trades; verify policy nonce movement, order status, trade history or runtime events, and market-data candles.
Do not tune consensus from local harnesses unless the live MAHI flags match; item266 is the local liveflags green baseline and item267 is the warning record.
Do not compare performance or liveness across runs without a clean reset, exact binary hash, and controlled topology.
Do not use local bridge mutators on a running validator set; reset/bootstrap-only local mutation is the only allowed testnet exception.
Do not confuse committed state-root convergence with runtime-event/read-model convergence. Trade history and candles are derived from event/read-model paths and need separate verification.
cross_experiment_guardrails.current_rfc027_diagnostic_note: A 2026-05-03 live sample after the latest redeploy showed all four validators reporting committed_state_root_hex=0x0426d3e6da0b7d71c900360d4a683d968b98d125e03350f77b5e60ff17f477af while direct kombat_getTradeHistory returned fills only on validator-1 for markets 7-11. That means the next investigation should isolate runtime event/trade-history visibility and market-data ingestion before making further bot-sizing or consensus-topology changes.

working_tree.reason: RFC027 market-maker, SDK, deployment, and MAHI payload-filter changes were built and deployed from the working tree before commit.

rfc027_program.funding_note: The MM account was funded during reset/seed with the intended multi-million USDC policy balance and RFC027 enrollment bond coverage. The active bot reports successful program enrollment at startup.

core_chain_change.problem: The real MM can naturally submit stale replace/cancel payloads when a previous replacement already executed or a lane reconciles late. Before this item, a stale replace in a MAHI payload could make merged MAHI execution fail with Order(UnknownRestingOrder), causing the same committed payload set to be retried and logging a block-execution failure loop.
core_chain_change.fix: Added a MAHI committed-payload prefilter in SingleNodeEngine so non-transient invalid preverified intents are converted into deterministic RejectedIntent records instead of making the MAHI block invalid. Later same-policy payload intents after a rejected predecessor are rejected as PredecessorIntentRejected. Single and merged MAHI execution now install those rejected intents alongside successfully applied payloads.
core_chain_change.consensus_rationale: The filter runs during deterministic block replay against current committed state, so proposer/follower nodes reject the same stale payloads and keep the block/state-root path live rather than wedging on an execution error.

local_bridge_hardening.problem: During the live rollout, policy-USDC and isolated-collateral bridge RPCs were used as a funding shortcut on a running four-validator network. Those methods mutate local committed state outside block consensus and caused validator head/state-root divergence.
local_bridge_hardening.fix: The public JSON-RPC bridge mutators kombat_setPolicyUsdcBalance, kombat_setEvmUsdcMinter, and kombat_setIsolatedCollateral now reject by default with local_bridge_mutations_disabled unless KOMBAT_LOCAL_BRIDGE_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=1 is explicitly set.
local_bridge_hardening.deployment_rule: Reset automation may enable the flag only while seeding the bootstrap validator before the remaining validators join from that seeded snapshot. The flag is disabled again before public runtime.

consensus_faucet_followup.problem: Disabling kombat_faucetFundAccount together with the bridge mutators broke the public account onboarding flow; users could create/link accounts but had no consensus-safe way to fund them.
consensus_faucet_followup.fix: Added BlockItem::Faucet and MahiBlock faucet payloads. kombat_faucetFundAccount now rate-limits the request, queues a pending faucet grant, waits for normal block/MAHI replay to commit, and returns the committed policy/EVM USDC balances. The grant updates policy balance, EVM USDC balance, and EVM USDC total supply through apply_committed_state_updates, so proposer/follower replay includes the funding in state_root.
consensus_faucet_followup.ui_followup: The marketing site and perps UI faucet buttons call the public consensus-carried faucet again instead of showing the paused-faucet state.

evm_wallet_owner_call_followup.problem: The perps activation modal still required users to paste an account-owner private key to create a trading policy. That is wrong for browser wallet users and conflicts with the intended wallet onboarding flow.
evm_wallet_owner_call_followup.fix: Added kombat_submitEvmOwnerCall beside the existing Ed25519 kombat_submitOwnerCall. Wallet-owned accounts use a deterministic owner principal derived from the linked EVM address; RPC verifies an EIP-712 EvmOwnerCall signature recovered to that linked wallet, then applies the same owner-call state transition. Ed25519 owner calls remain intact for bots and operator tooling. The perps UI now creates wallet-owned accounts, funds them through the consensus faucet, and asks the connected wallet to sign policy creation instead of asking for an owner private key.
evm_wallet_owner_call_followup.consensus_rationale: This is an authorization-layer extension over existing owner-call mutations, not a change to policy/session semantics. Both owner modes mint identical policy records and keep Ed25519 session keys for fast intent signing.

bot_change.implementation: Rust kombat_mm_bot, not the previous shell stopgap.
changes: Bounded concurrent quoting across independent nonce lanes via KOMBAT_MM_BOT_QUOTE_CONCURRENCY.
Per-failure lane reconciliation refreshes current resting order state before the next replacement attempt.
Detailed JSON-RPC error data is logged for stale nonce, rejection, and timeout diagnosis.
Post-only replacement prices are clamped against top-of-book snapshots so bids stay below the best ask and asks stay above the best bid when the mark lags the book.

llm_trader_chart_candle_change.problem: The order book had live RFC027 maker liquidity, but the chart could still be empty because candles are built from taker match_filled events and the deployed LLM trader was repeatedly deciding hold.
llm_trader_chart_candle_change.fix: Added an explicit testnet-only taker cadence to the Python llm-trader. When AND_TESTNET_TAKER_CADENCE_ENABLED=1 and the model returns hold, it submits a tiny IOC order at the current touch, alternates buy/sell, and stays bounded by local max trade/max position plus the on-chain policy.

ui_chart_change.problem: The market-data service stores candle buckets using deterministic chain event timestamps. TradingView requests wall-clock ranges, so a wall-clock getBars request can return no rows even when market-data has valid chain-time candles.
ui_chart_change.fix: LiveTradingViewChart now retries empty wall-clock candle queries against the full chain-time range and shifts chain-time bars/live taker fills onto the current wall-clock bucket before handing them to TradingView.

ui_request_storm_followup.problem: TradingView repeatedly requested old wall-clock candle ranges; the first UI fallback queried the full chain-time candle range on each empty response, doubling the request load and producing a visible /api/market-data/candles request storm.
ui_request_storm_followup.fix: LiveTradingViewChart now learns a chain-time to wall-clock offset once, maps subsequent requested wall-clock ranges back into chain-time ranges, filters returned bars to the visible wall-clock range, and only performs the full-history bootstrap before the offset is known.

llm_trader_followup.problem: The Python test taker accepted submissions with pending_reason=stale_market_data and then immediately advanced local position/client state, causing repeated submissions while the policy nonce had not advanced.
llm_trader_followup.fix: The agent now records the submitted nonce as pending, skips further submissions until the on-chain policy nonce advances, and logs structured JSON-RPC error code/data for failed submissions. Fleet deployment disables the old fund command because deterministic reset seeding owns collateral.

leader_forwarding_one_round_lag_fix_2026.problem: After faucet, policy creation, and collateral deposit succeeded on public RPC, a market order failed with JSON-RPC error -32000: leader forwarding retry failed: current leader 0x0303... is stale at round 2565 (local round 2566). A one-round skew between submitter and target leader is normal during MAHI round advancement and should not fail the public write path.
leader_forwarding_one_round_lag_fix_2026.fix: Allow a one-round tolerance when preflighting the current leader's /network/bootstrap round before forwarding a public write. Leaders lagging by more than the tolerance still fail as stale.
leader_forwarding_one_round_lag_fix_2026.consensus_rationale: Forwarding only chooses the admission endpoint; block replay remains authoritative. A one-round lag tolerance avoids false-negative public writes during normal round skew without accepting materially stale leaders.
leader_forwarding_one_round_lag_fix_2026.validation_status: documented before deployment; local fmt/build/test already passed; pending redeploy and live account/faucet/deposit/trade acceptance rerun.

initial_margin_tick_lot_scaling_fix_2026.problem: After reset, a public SDK acceptance run could create an account, faucet fund it, create a policy, and deposit collateral, but even a 1-lot BTC market order was committed as intent_rejected with rejection_reason=internal_error. The underlying guard compared raw price_ticks * quantity_lots against micro-USDC collateral when reserving initial margin, instead of first scaling by the market's tick_size_bps and lot_size_microunits.
initial_margin_tick_lot_scaling_fix_2026.fix: Scale initial-margin notional through scaled_raw_tick_lot_notional_usdc before comparing the required initial margin against isolated collateral. This aligns the order-placement margin guard with fill notional, policy notional, and the live market tick/lot configuration.
initial_margin_tick_lot_scaling_fix_2026.consensus_rationale: The fix runs inside deterministic intent replay. Every validator computes the same scaled notional from committed market config, mark price, order book, and intent body, so this changes admission correctness without introducing proposer-local state.

deployment_wall_clock_block_timestamp_fi.problem: After the corrected validator binary was deployed and reset, the public SDK flow reached a real BTC fill, and QuestDB stored a 1m candle. The chart still saw no candles because reset/bootstrap block timestamps were fixed at 1100/1200ms, so committed fill events bucketed at timestamp_ms=60000 while the UI requested wall-clock ranges around the current epoch.
deployment_wall_clock_block_timestamp_fi.fix: Changed live-testnet Ansible defaults so KOMBAT_BOOTSTRAP_EMPTY_BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_MS, KOMBAT_GENESIS_TIMESTAMP_MS, and and_chain_seed_timestamp_ms are derived from the controller wall clock at reset time, with explicit env overrides still supported. This keeps committed fill-event timestamps in the same epoch-ms domain as the UI and market-data candle queries.
deployment_wall_clock_block_timestamp_fi.consensus_rationale: The timestamp is still part of committed block data and is identical across validators because it is written into the deployed validator env / seed playbook before reset. This changes live-testnet deployment configuration, not per-validator runtime clock reads during replay.
deployment_wall_clock_block_timestamp_fi.validation_status: Ansible syntax check passed before deploy. deploy.yml installed validator_binary_sha256=717fdff56d2b86703ecce73d200673b6e365747f2fceb34c75db4884de827dfa on all four validators. reset_seed_and_start_perps_demo.yml completed, and the public SDK acceptance run produced a wall-clock QuestDB candle for fill event seq 1755 at timestamp_ms=1777818960000.

risk_snapshot_tick_lot_scaling_fix_2026_.problem: After the public acceptance flow filled a 1-lot BTC taker order and a wall-clock candle appeared, kombat_getAccountRiskSummary still reported the account under maintenance with multi-thousand-USDC negative equity. risk_snapshot_tick_lot_scaling_fix_2026_.consensus_rationale: These calculations run inside deterministic block replay and RPC state reads using committed market config and position ledgers. All validators derive the same scaled values from the same raw ledger state; no local clock or proposer-only data is introduced.

llm_taker_pending_status_and_direct_rpc_.problem: After the public edge was healthy, candles still stalled because the Python LLM taker fleet could hold a stale pending nonce locally. Some submitted intents expired or disappeared from the queried validator's local view, but the agent kept treating the nonce as blocked. The deployed fleet also still read/wrote through the public edge load balancer, so getPolicy/getIntentStatus and submitIntent could observe different validator-local admission views during high churn.
llm_taker_pending_status_and_direct_rpc_.fix: Added Python SDK get_intent_status, taught llm-trader to store pending intent ids, clear terminal processed/expired/rejected statuses, and clear stale unknown/non-queued pending ids after the configured intent TTL. The loadgen inventory now pins the fleet to validator-1 direct RPC for nonce-sensitive testnet taker traffic.
llm_taker_pending_status_and_direct_rpc_.production_rationale: The SDK/status change is production-useful for agents. The direct-RPC pin is a testnet operational workaround, not a production routing model; production should rely on robust leader/owner relay and status convergence behind the public edge.

mahi_wall_clock_runtime_timestamp_fix_20.problem: After reset-time timestamps were corrected, the chain still drifted behind wall clock during continuous auto-MAHI production. spawn_auto_mahi_round advanced scheduled timestamps by the configured interval from the previous head; when real commit cadence was slower than the target interval, committed order_filled/order_replaced events lagged wall clock by roughly 50 minutes. QuestDB candles therefore stopped near the lagged committed timestamp even while validators and bots were active.
mahi_wall_clock_runtime_timestamp_fix_20.fix: rebase_auto_network_round_timestamp now rebases the scheduled timestamp against wall-clock unix_now_ms in addition to head_timestamp + interval. Future auto-MAHI blocks catch up to current epoch time instead of accumulating timestamp lag.
mahi_wall_clock_runtime_timestamp_fix_20.consensus_rationale: The producer timestamp remains committed block data and validators replay it deterministically. This does not read local wall clock during follower replay; it only changes the timestamp chosen by the local auto-producer for new proposed blocks.

items.name: bootstrap-only local bridge mutations
items.why_not_production: The bridge mutators rewrite local committed state outside block consensus if left enabled on a running validator set.
items.required_exit: Keep KOMBAT_LOCAL_BRIDGE_MUTATIONS_ENABLED disabled at public runtime; use consensus-carried faucet, signed intents, and block-carried RFC027 actions instead.

items.name: operator/governance bridge for RFC027 Define/Retire
items.why_not_production: DefineProgram and RetireProgram need explicit governance signer configuration rather than operator-token bridge admission.
items.required_exit: Implement and deploy governance-signed RFC027 program submission before exposing public governance changes.

items.name: MAHI payload sharding override
items.status: active for the RFC027 MM/taker live-testnet rollout as of 2026-05-03; inventory defaults KOMBAT_MAHI_PAYLOAD_SHARDING=0 until owner-relay/status convergence is hardened
items.why_not_production: Disabling payload sharding lets producers drain all local ready frontiers instead of only their policy shard. Replay remains deterministic, but throughput/capacity isolation is weaker and duplicate inclusion pressure increases.
items.required_exit: Re-enable default payload sharding after owner-relay/high-volume bot submission is proven stable behind the public edge.

items.name: single-leader synchronous MAHI rollout pin

items.name: restart persistence
items.why_not_production: Plain service restart can boot a fresh in-memory engine unless started from a saved snapshot or remote bootstrap.
items.required_exit: Add durable block/state persistence or a non-destructive restart playbook that saves and reloads latest.snapshot before peers/ingress resume.

items.name: RFC039 rate limiting
items.why_not_production: Public signed delegation and RFC027 submissions are bounded by pending caps but not yet rate-limited for adversarial public traffic.
items.required_exit: Deploy RFC039-style rate limits or equivalent ingress throttling before adversarial/public production operation.

position_notional_read_model_and_live_ti.problem: A browser trade using 50% of a 100 USDC account showed a sane ticket estimate around 500 USDC notional, but the post-fill position table showed open_notional around 50,010,865,703 USDC. Live kombat_getAccountTradingState for account 1777823989233583 exposed raw tick-lot ledger values in PositionResponse, while the live market seed used tick_size_bps=1 with lot_size_microunits=1. The result was two independent scaling errors: RPC consumers rendered raw tick-lot values as micro-USDC, and risk/margin treated displayed BTC prices as 100x smaller than the UI ticket.
position_notional_read_model_and_live_ti.fix: NodeRpcService now scales PositionResponse and PositionHistoryRecordResponse open_notional, buy_notional, sell_notional, and realized_pnl from raw tick-lot ledger units into micro-USDC using the committed PerpetualMarket tick_size_bps and lot_size_microunits. The live testnet market seed now sets tick_size_bps=100 for markets 7-11, which matches the UI price scale and current chain notional formula. The perps UI position table displays net base size instead of raw lot count.
position_notional_read_model_and_live_ti.consensus_rationale: The RPC read-model scaling is not a consensus state change; the raw ledger remains unchanged and deterministic. The tick_size_bps correction is committed market configuration seeded during a full reset, so every validator replays the same market config and risk calculations.
position_notional_read_model_and_live_ti.deployment_status: Deployed validator_binary_sha256=2f9cc6c419d52a415e1eef779187b742e84be23c3767c960a5c05b50176a2292 to all four validators, completed a full reset/seed/start run, deployed perps UI sonatribe/and-dex-ui:0.1.20, and reran the public account/faucet/policy/deposit/trade acceptance flow.

mm_taker_execution_path_fix_2026_05_03.problem: After UI candle timezone and read-model fixes, live trade candles still stopped because the RFC027 Rust MM and Python taker fleet were not producing continuous fills. Live evidence showed validator-local policy nonce divergence under MAHI payload sharding: validator-1 reported advanced policy nonces for 27010101 and MM lanes while validators 2-4 still reported earlier nonces for the same policies. The bots were pinned to validator-1, while policy-owner shards still saw nonce_frontier and let taker intents expire. The MM also tripped daily_volume_exceeded because 15M-lot quote replacement churn consumed the lane policy's submitted-notional cap.
mm_taker_execution_path_fix_2026_05_03.fix: For the resettable live testnet, set KOMBAT_MAHI_PAYLOAD_SHARDING=0 through inventory and pin market-data ingestion to validator-1 so bot admission, execution view, and candle ingestion read one validator path while owner-relay/status convergence is hardened. The MM deploy playbook now renders KOMBAT_MM_BOT_POLICY_MAX_VOLUME_PER_DAY_MICRO_USDC=1000000000000000000 and KOMBAT_MM_BOT_INTENT_STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS=120000. The Rust MM now reconciles a timed-out submission against open orders and treats the quote as successful if the replacement client_order_id is already visible on book. The Python taker now preserves duplicate_policy_nonce as a pending nonce and retains unknown/non-queued pending intents during a bounded grace window instead of immediately resubmitting the same nonce. The live resettable-testnet LLM taker cadence was raised in the effective kombat_loadgen host group from dust sizing (1-lot orders, 2-lot max trade, 10-lot max position) to 100000-lot IOC cadence orders with matching max trade/max position so taker flow produces visible, economically meaningful fills against the RFC027 MM book.
mm_taker_execution_path_fix_2026_05_03.production_rationale: The MM open-order reconciliation and taker duplicate-nonce handling are production-useful agent hardening. Disabling MAHI payload sharding and pinning market-data to validator-1 are testnet-only operational relaxations; production must restore sharding and make owner-relay/status convergence robust behind the public edge.
mm_taker_execution_path_fix_2026_05_03.deployment_status: First redeploy/reset with payload sharding disabled produced real fills on validator-1 and public market-data candles, but validators diverged at MAHI commit_log_hash/state_hash and validator-1 alone advanced taker/MM policy nonces. A follow-up discovered the intended single-leader reset incorrectly used KOMBAT_MAHI_MULTILEADER=1, which the parser treats as default multileader; the next reset must pin KOMBAT_MAHI_MULTILEADER=0 and KOMBAT_MAHI_ASYNC_BLOCK_BROADCAST=false to verify the real MM/taker path without multi-leader divergence. After observing live taker logs still submitting 1-lot IOC orders, the effective kombat_loadgen inventory now raises the resettable-testnet taker cadence size to 100000 lots before the next LLM trader fleet redeploy.

mahi_multileader_env_semantics_fix_2026_.problem: The intended single-leader reset was configured as KOMBAT_MAHI_MULTILEADER=1, but the runtime parser defines 1/true/on as 'enable default multileader'. Live metrics after the reset still reported number_of_leaders=4, so the reset did not actually test the planned single-leader relaxation.

mm_owner_call_partial_fanout_fix_2026_05.problem: After the 2026-05-03 reset/deploy, the RFC027 Rust MM bot crash-looped during lane-policy bootstrap. Each restart created one additional lane policy, but submit_typed_owner_call returned rpc error -32021 owner call rejected, so the bot exited before reaching quote placement and market 7 had an empty book.

live_evidence.log_pattern: Error: create lane policy 26000175 failed: rpc error -32021: owner call rejected, then 26000176, 26000177, etc.
live_evidence.state_observation: kombat_getPolicy showed the supposedly failed lane policies existed and maker account 260001 nonce/controllers advanced, proving the owner-call result was ambiguous after partial fanout rather than a pure local rejection.

mm_owner_call_partial_fanout_fix_2026_05.fix: Updated kombat_mm_bot ensure_lane_policies to poll kombat_getPolicy after an owner-call submission error. If the target lane policy exists, the bot treats the ambiguous response as applied, advances the local account nonce cursor, and continues bootstrap instead of exiting.
mm_owner_call_partial_fanout_fix_2026_05.validation_status: pending local loadgen build, bot redeploy, live order-book check, and end-to-end account/faucet/deposit/trade acceptance run.

restart_persistence_gap_2026_05_03.problem: A plain service restart can appear to lose chain state because the current validator process is in-memory unless started from KOMBAT_LOAD_SNAPSHOT_PATH or remote bootstrap. The seed flow saves bootstrap-seeded.snapshot and uses it for a one-shot bootstrap restart, then removes KOMBAT_LOAD_SNAPSHOT_PATH; a later restart of validator-1 can therefore boot a fresh engine and downstream validators/ingress can bootstrap from that fresh head.
restart_persistence_gap_2026_05_03.what_is_not_a_bug: reset_state.yml and reset_seed_and_start_perps_demo.yml intentionally delete /var/lib/and-chain and QuestDB/limiter state as part of complete reset runs.
restart_persistence_gap_2026_05_03.todo: Add a non-destructive restart/deploy path that saves a latest snapshot, keeps a stable load target such as /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots/latest.snapshot, starts validator-1 from that snapshot, then restarts the rest of the validator set and ingress services. Longer-term fix is durable node block/state persistence rather than operator-managed snapshot handoff.

faucet_forwarding_partial_response_fix_2.problem: The public faucet request for account 1780000812537992 returned JSON-RPC error -32000 timeout recovery quorum unavailable, but kombat_getWalletBalances immediately showed policy_usdc_balance=100000000 and evm_usdc_balance=25000000 for the target address. The forwarded write reached the leader and committed, but the ingress/follower surfaced timeout-recovery failure instead of retrying the idempotent forwarded request.
faucet_forwarding_partial_response_fix_2.fix: Treat leader timeout recovery as best-effort inside the forwarded-write retry loop. A failed timeout-recovery attempt is recorded/logged but no longer aborts the user request before the bounded forwarding retries are exhausted.
faucet_forwarding_partial_response_fix_2.consensus_rationale: Forwarded public writes in this path are idempotent by intent id, action id, or faucet target address. Retrying after an ambiguous transport failure is safer than returning an error while the leader may already have committed the state transition.
faucet_forwarding_partial_response_fix_2.validation_status: targeted local RPC tests passed; pending Linux rebuild, redeploy, and end-to-end account/faucet/deposit/trade acceptance run.
